mapper.select: SELECT BOOKSET_ID code,BOOKSET_NAME name,BOOKSET_NAME shortName,BOOKSET_ID hidCode FROM BOK_BOOKSET a where 1=1 order by bookset_type,BOOKSET_ID

SELECT BOOKSET_ID code,BOOKSET_NAME name,BOOKSET_NAME shortName,BOOKSET_ID hidCode FROM BOK_BOOKSET a where 1=1
and bookset_type='01' order by bookset_type,BOOKSET_ID

SELECT BOOKSET_ID code,BOOKSET_NAME name,BOOKSET_NAME shortName,BOOKSET_ID hidCode FROM BOK_BOOKSET where 1=1
AND BOOKSET_TYPE = #{booksetType}
AND (BOOKSET_ID like concat('%',concat(#{param},'%')) OR BOOKSET_NAME like concat('%',concat(#{param},'%')))
order by bookset_type,BOOKSET_ID

SELECT A.BOOKSET_ID AS booksetId, A.BOOKSET_NAME AS booksetName, A.BOOKSET_TYPE AS booksetType, A.ACCT_SUBJECT_ID AS acctSubjectId, A.STANDARD_CCY AS standardCcy, A.STANDARD_CCY AS standardCcyCode, A.ACCT_SUBJECT_TYPE AS acctSubjectType, A.BOOKSET_ID_TMPL AS booksetIdTmpl, B.ACCT_STANDARD_NAME AS acctStandard, A.START_DATE AS startDate, A.END_DATE AS endDate FROM BOK_BOOKSET A LEFT JOIN bok_ACCT_STANDARD B ON B.ACCT_STANDARD_ID=A.ACCT_STANDARD WHERE BOOKSET_TYPE=#{booksetType}
AND BOOKSET_Id=#{booksetName}
SELECT DISTINCT BOOKSET_ID,BOOKSET_NAME FROM BOK_BOOKSET order by BOOKSET_ID

select SEQ_NO id, GROUP_NAME text from SYS_BATCH_PRD_GRP where 1=1 --system_code = 'SYS'
AND GROUP_NAME like '%' || #{search} || '%'

SELECT BOOKSET_ID id,BOOKSET_NAME text FROM BOK_BOOKSET
AND BOOKSET_TYPE = #{booksetType}
AND (BOOKSET_ID like concat('%',concat(#{search},'%')) OR BOOKSET_NAME like concat('%',concat(#{search},'%')))
order by bookset_type,BOOKSET_ID
